bio.text: Kam Buckner, a Democrat, has represented Illinois's 26th House District since January 2019, according to the General Assembly.

The General Assembly biography lists Buckner as vice president of governmental affairs at Outfront Media, a former executive director of World Sport Chicago and a former manager of neighborhood and government relations for the Chicago Cubs.
The biography says Buckner is a former aide to U.S. Senator Richard Durbin and New Orleans Mayor Mitch Landrieu, and a former member of the Chicago State University Board of Trustees.
Buckner holds a B.A. from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and a J.D. from DePaul University College of Law, the biography says.
